name: demo-1-readiness
description: Demo 1: ODSB readiness audit against Acme DS. ODSB is installed from GitHub at a pinned commit.

scripts.doctor: pnpm run before && pnpm run odsb doctor --config systems.config.json
scripts.extract: pnpm run before && pnpm run odsb extract --config systems.config.json
scripts.audit:before: pnpm run odsb audit --system acme-before --config systems.config.json
scripts.audit:after: pnpm run odsb audit --system acme --config systems.config.json
